text:
rachel: quick note  new mini-series: 'RefactorKit Quickstarts'  3 micro-tutorials + one tiny starter repo + live mentor drop-in. deliverables: launch post, tutorial cadence, starter repo, webinar funnel, inbound routing. short plan below.

omar: nice. i'll scaffold the starter repo with a single Dockerfile + fast run script. MIT. ETA Mon.

tess: i'll draft three labs (15-20m each): setup, perf tuning, and deploy patterns. aim for reproducible prompts + a tiny bench blurb. drafts by Thu.

hugo: i'll own the landing page & emails (confirm, 24h reminder, follow-up with repo + replay). will add UTMs and HubSpot tags.

rachel: webinar format: 35m build + 20m Q&A. landing page needs gated form and Slack CTA to join #refactorkit. who sets the HubSpot workflow?

hugo: i will. route registrants into a nurture list; if they complete >50% labs or click "talk to eng" route to SE. tag leads `refactorkit_interest`.

omar: will include a small `bench.sh` and a 3-line benchmark summary for the post (latency/cost numbers).

tess: content tree i'll push to docs:
```
/tutorials/refactorkit/lab-1-quickstart.md
/tutorials/refactorkit/lab-2-batching-and-caching.md
/tutorials/refactorkit/lab-3-prod-deploy.md
/starter/refactorkit/README.md
/benchmarks/refactorkit-demo-blurb.md
```

rachel: marketing-bot please create a review task for the post next Wed.

marketing-bot: task created /tasks/7102 assigned to @rachel @hugo @tess  review due Wed 09:00 PT.

hugo: metrics to track: landing CTR, signups, webinar RSVPs, attendance %, lab completions, repo stars, routed MQLs. will add dashboards to Amplitude + HubSpot.

omar: small ops note: add CONTRIBUTING.md to explain mentor-led sessions and issue templates.

tess: can we recruit 1-2 mentors from community? i'll put out a call in the newsletter.

rachel: timeline recap: repo Mon, tutorials Thu, post review Wed, publish Thu, webinar ~2w after publish. sync Mon 10:00 PT. TL;DR: ship starter + labs this week, landing & emails by Thu, publish next Thu, run drop-in 2w later. :rocket:
